# DGTL Connector by DGTL Sunrise

DGTL Connector is a Grok Bot plugin (also Cursor, Grok Build, and other MCP hosts) that connects agents to marketing accounts you already administer. No DGTL Sunrise account is required to start. Free GA4, Search Console, and Tag Manager run on your machine (read and manage). Klaviyo is local on the same machine with a key you hold. Pro ($19/mo) unlocks hosted Google Ads, Meta, and TikTok through the plugin’s Pro plan. Install: `grok plugin install dgtlsunrise/dgtl-connector`. Source: https://github.com/dgtlsunrise/dgtl-connector

## When to use this

Use this index when an agent needs a short map of public docs and install facts for DGTL Connector by DGTL Sunrise. Prefer the structured agent document for capabilities. Prefer the full text when you need platforms, guardrails, and company detail in one place. Prefer the developer resources page for local MCP manifests and GitHub.

## Agent notes

Send `Accept: text/markdown` (preferring text/markdown over text/html) for companion markdown twins of HTML pages. Homepage `/?mode=agent` returns application/json from `agent.json` and wins over HTML and markdown negotiation for that query. DGTL Connector is a local stdio plugin (`bin/dgtl-connector-mcp`); see `/developers` and `/server.json`.

First chat: paste the Documentation starter prompt so the Bot uses `dgtl-connector` tools and lists accounts instead of guessing. For Pro, paste the Documentation What is Pro upgrade prompt (Polar $19 / month at https://buy.polar.sh/polar_cl_aIrywIIxJ2cOwj70VQAcJn2umEgSS9kWBMUJS241Dll). Redeem the license on the install. Never paste tokens or license keys into chat. Long How to use and What is Pro copy: `/documentation` and `/llms-full.txt`.
